FOR THE HUMAN: decide the gender of मिथुन here. (a) As drafted: मिथुनम् नपुं by the Amarakośa (§5.7 order), with masculine ārṣa qualifiers (masculine by sense, standing for the pair). This is consistent with चारुनिःस्वनम् नपुं, तत् मिथुनं in the vyākhyā, and मिथुनात् (v.10). (b) Or मिथुनम् पुं by Apte (m. also). Then चरन्तम्, अनपायिनम् and चारु-निःस्वनम् are all पुं with anvita मिथुनम्, the ārṣa notes are dropped, and the vyākhyā's 'तत् मिथुनं' becomes 'तं मिथुनं'. The reviewer prefers (a).

VR.1.2.40.note: Second pass. Fix applied exactly: the last sentence now reads तत् पुनः पुनः उच्चार्यमाणं श्लोकः अभवत्, with no agent added (it keeps the passive participle). Nothing else changed; check_layers OK. First pass: Padaccheda right (श्लोकत्वम् kept whole as a taddhita, against the seed's श्लोक-त्वम्; सः अनुव्याहरणात्). Padārtha and anvaya right. But the last sentence makes the disciples the agent of the repetition (अस्माभिः … गीयमानम्). The verse says only अनुव्याहरणात् भूयः, and the sarga map glosses it neutrally (पुनः पुनः उच्चारणात्). Commentators differ on whose repetition is meant (the disciples', or Brahmā's re-utterance in verse 31; from memory), so the vyākhyā should not decide it. Remark, no change required: अन्यैः पादैः समाना would be more exact as अन्येषां पादानां सङ्ख्यया समाना.
